ecosystem.title: A Unified Ecosystem of Excellence
ecosystem.text: Our strength lies in our diversity — a family of companies operating across lifestyle, engineering, and social impact sectors. Each company operates independently but is united by a shared vision: to deliver excellence while transforming lives.

profiles.name: CNM Essentials
profiles.text: A premium lifestyle brand offering luxury fragrances, home décor, and body care products crafted for the intentional woman and the discerning home. CNM Essentials is the fragrance and lifestyle destination for those who believe that how you live at home reflects who you are in the world.
profiles.value: Purpose-crafted luxury for modern living — combining natural ingredients, artisanal quality, and a deep sense of intentionality that transforms everyday rituals into meaningful experiences.

profiles.name: CNM Spectra
profiles.text: A premium eyewear brand redefining how Africans see the world. CNM Spectra offers an expertly curated range of prescription frames, sunglasses, contact lenses, and accessories that merge optical precision with contemporary style — serving the style-conscious professional who refuses to compromise on quality or visual clarity.
profiles.value: Precision optics tailored for the African market — where how you see the world matters just as much as how the world sees you. Premium quality without compromise.

profiles.name: CNMWorX Limited
profiles.tagline: Engineering the future, one project at a time.
profiles.text: Registered in Nigeria in 2019 and ISO 9001:2015 certified, CNMWorX Limited is a preferred engineering and technical services company specialising in Industrial and Process Automation & Control, Instrumentation, Power Electronics, and ICT. Acting as a trusted System Integrator, CNMWorX delivers bespoke solutions to IOCs, Independent Oil Companies, and Industrial Services Companies across West and Central Africa.
profiles.value: ISO 9001:2015-certified engineering precision with a multidisciplinary team delivering weekly reporting, full project management flexibility, and truly tailor-made solutions — whether embedded in the client's organisation or managed end-to-end independently.
card: Serving IOCs across West & Central Africa

profiles.name: CNM Foundation
profiles.tagline: Zero percent of zero is zero — so we give everything.
profiles.text: The social impact and philanthropic arm of CNM Group — a faith-rooted, community-driven organisation committed to education, women's economic empowerment, youth development, and community health across Nigeria and the African diaspora. Active for over five years through informal programmes, CNM Foundation is now formalising its reach — scaling impact, deepening partnerships, and amplifying its voice where it matters most.
profiles.value: Transformation begins where investment meets intentionality — every child deserves an education, every woman deserves an opportunity, and every community deserves to thrive.
card: Active in Nigeria and the African diaspora
